text:
Glycolysis is activated at the onset of exercise, and when glycolytic flux outpaces mitochondrial pyruvate oxidation, pyruvate is converted to lactate via lactate dehydrogenase to regenerate NAD+ and sustain glycolysis. The option "pyruvate cannot be formed from glucose breakdown" is incorrect, since pyruvate is the normal end product of glycolysis.
CONFIDENCE: 95
